interpretation: Compare received against its immediate parent wake and against release. Wake is used unchanged from the preceding confirmation. Selection for consideration does not establish release qualification.

protocol.metrics: Ratios are calculated from per-arm sample medians for each workload. Paired observations compare the three arms within the same round. Neither trial populations nor guardrails are pooled.
protocol.originalTrialGuardrails: On all four workloads the candidate must achieve at least 95% of throughput, at most 110% of delivery p99, and at most 110% of allocation relative to both parent and v11. Contended median allocation must fall by at least 36 B/notification relative to parent; allocation must fall in at least two of three pairs in both the contended and eight-extension workloads.
protocol.supplementalGuardrails: Only an originally qualifying candidate can qualify here. Repeat all nine isolated JVMs independently and meet the same three parent and release numeric budgets on that workload.

observedOverlap.scope: The previous experiment’s evidence verification shared part of this JVM wall-clock interval. Its exact overlap with warmup or measurement is unknown. This row is retained. The isolated control was declared before inspecting the full result; it is a separate required check, not a replacement or pooled repeat.

provenance.digestAlgorithm: SHA-256. JAR digests cover raw bytes; class directory digests cover UTF-8 JSON of the ordered list of relative member names and raw member hashes. The release list is in classpath order. Identical entries inherit their release hash. The per-trial JFR and JSONL hashes are the previously verified collection hash ledgers; packaging independently rechecked the smaller JSONL records.
